d.body: All 276 tests pass, including real concurrent CLI processes, linked worktrees, clone import, lease expiry and stale-token rejection, dependency races, long notes, and lock recovery after process death. Workspace Clippy, formatting, Rust 1.88 compatibility, release builds, cargo-deny, task-history validation, and a TUI smoke check pass. Opened draft PR 120 for review; it remains unmerged.
